question: Why should a multi-agent system's shared coordination log (e.g. praxis-inbox.md) be append-only rather than mutable in place?
summary: Reasoned from concurrency/audit primitives to the event-sourcing pattern (append-only log as source of truth, derived state via fold/replay, lock-free merge, audit trail) independently of the term; corpus confirms this as the standard pattern, including the same raw-log-plus-snapshot file split this repo already uses (praxis-inbox.md / praxis-inbox-processed.md).
